docs.description:
A formatted price, with an optional "was" price and the percentage saved.

Formatting goes through `Intl.NumberFormat`, so currency symbols, decimal
rules and grouping follow the locale rather than being hand-rolled — 1 999 €
in French, $1,999.00 in US English, ¥1,999 with no decimals in Japanese.

props.name: amount
props.description: The price to show, in major units (e.g. 19.99)

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class names to merge with the component root element

props.name: compareAt
props.description: The previous price, when `amount` is a discount — rendered struck through with the saving

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO 4217 currency code; defaults to USD

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale used for formatting; defaults to the browser's, then en-US

props.name: size
props.description: Controls the type size; defaults to md
